story_body: As a user, I want to add tasks to my to-do list using a single command, so that I can efficiently manage my daily tasks.
ac_body:
- `todo add "Buy groceries"` -> The task "Buy groceries" should appear in the to-do list.
- `todo add "Call John"` -> The task "Call John" should appear in the to-do list.
- `todo add "Read a book"` -> The task "Read a book" should appear in the to-do list.
- `todo list` -> The output should include all tasks added so far, in the order they were added.
- `todo add ""` -> The command should return an error message indicating that the task description cannot be empty.
- `todo add "Buy groceries" --priority high` -> The task "Buy groceries" should be marked as high priority in the to-do list.
